blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Bam Aquino and Pinoy Pop group SB19 have crafted a bill to protect and aid Filipino artists, which will soon be filed in the Senate, Aquino said Monday. This comes the same day the Senate adopted a resolution commending SB19, popularly hailed as the “Kings of P-Pop,” for its historic first performance by a Filipino act at the Lollapalooza stage earlier this year. According to Aquino, the measure will seek to establish an agency under the Department of Trade and Industry to protect Filipino artists working abroad and promote Philippine artistry and culture internationally.
